tei:div.tei:p: 561) ༄༅/ chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod skor gyi rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i tshogs mchod kyi 'don 'grigs gsal bar bkod pa bzhugs/ 562)

bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ de la 'dir rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu'i sgo nas tshogs mchod ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lag 'grigs su bkod pa la/ thog mar dkyil 'khor bshams bkod sogs kyi rim pa spyi ltar grub mthar/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ma lus sems can sogs/ gshegs su gsol/ hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i sogs/ siddhi hūm̐: gnas mchog 'di ru sogs/ bcom ldan 'dir ni sogs/ 'dir ni gzugs dang sogs/ sku gsum yongs rdzogs sogs/ bla ma sku khams sogs/ e ma hoḥ spros bral chos 563)kyi sogs sku gsum gsol 'debs dang*/ e ma hoḥ nub phyogs bde ba sogs/ e ma hoḥ rgyal kun dgongs pa sogs/ siddhi hūm̐: mtsho dbus ge sar sogs/ o rgyan rin po che la sogs/ lan gsum/ hrīḥ dkon mchog rtsa gsum sogs/ skyabs gnas bslu med sogs/ e ma hoḥ khyab bdag gdod ma'i sogs/ shog: e ma hoḥ bde gshegs snying po'i sogs/ shog: e ma hoḥ gzhi dbyings thog ma'i sogs/ cig e ma hoḥ chos dbyings 'dus ma sogs/ byang chub shogaḥ skye ba kun tu sogs/ shog: spyi gces sngon 'gro las/ rdor bsor dril 'dzin bcas/ rang nyid skad cig gis sogs/ hūm̐ dzñā na badzra hrīḥ rdo rje thugs kar bsor/ hūm̐ dzñā na badzra/ g.yon bsgyur bkan gyi dril bu dkur brten/ muṃ: 'khyud rgya dang dril gsil bya/ rdor gsor dril 'dzin/ rang dam tshig sogs/ badzra sa ma ya/ bsdu rgya se gol/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam ho: sgo bzhi'i rgya smin gling ltar dang*/ ḍā 'ur 564) ḍā bcas/ spyan 'dren rta/ hūm̐: sngon gyi sogs/ dngos grub stsolaḥ ḍā bcad/ sngags bcas ḍā 'ur ḍā nyis bcad bya/ rdor bsor dril 'dzin/ oṃ swā bha wa sogs/ gsil/ stong pa sogs/ bsam teḥ gsil/ oṃ āḥ sogs/ lan bdun/ sngags rjes mar gsil/ rdor bsor dril 'dzin bcas/ slar yang sogs/ bla mas bsang chu byin brlabs bya/ rdor bsor dril 'dzin/

bsang chu mchod rdzas la bran bzhin/ a mṛ ta dang*/ swā bha wa sogs la gsil/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ stong pa'i sogs/ gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs/ mchod rol/ ḍā 'ur ring thung gnyis/ mchan/ gnas dang mchod pa'i sogs/ rigs 'dus gsol 'debs las/ e ma hoḥ chos sku kun bzang sogs/ byang chub shogaḥ rang gi snying ga'i sogs/ dzaḥ rdor dril bcas/ bsdu rgya se gol/ rigs 'dus sgrub thabs las/ skyabs 'gro la rdor thal dril 'dzin/ rtsa gdangs/ na moḥ ka dag skye med sogs/ skyobasaḥ gsil/ lan gsum/ sems bskyed la/ hoḥ gnyis snang lam gol sogs/ shogaḥ gsil/ lan gsum/ yan bdun la/ hoḥ rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i sogs/ bsngoḥ gsil/ trām̐/ phyi yi maṇḍal sogs/ mjug gi sngags la dril bu gsil bzhin 565) mchod/ mchod rol/ tshogs zhing bsdu bar/ rdor dril bcas/ rang rgya/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam hoḥ tshogs zhing sogs/ gyuraḥ bsdu rgya se gol/ dkar gtor la/ pad skor rang rgya/ nam mkha' mdzod sngags/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ lhug 'don/ hūm̐ḥ mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs/ oṃ sarba lo ka sogs gsil bzh-in pas/ bla ma nas mchod/ dril bu tshig rdung byed bzhin/ na moḥ bdag gi bsam pa'i sogs/ dkar mchod mgron la mchod pa dang*/ zhes kha bsgyur bya zhing*/ 'byung gyur cigaḥ mchod rol/ bgegs gtor zur bkol las/ oṃ hrīḥpadma ta kritta sogs/ bstim moḥ ḍā 'ur mtshams bcad/ hūm̐ hrīḥ la ḍā phyir bskor ba 'og ma kun la 'gres/ spyan 'dren rta/ ḍā bcas/ ye shes rol pa sogs/ sha ya hūm̐ḥ nas ḍā bcad cing bzhag oṃ swa bhā wa sogs dril gsil/ stong pa sogs/ gyur/ rdor dril med par mkha' lding gi spyi ltar gyis/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ lan gsum/ ha ho hrīḥ rdor dril bcas lcags kyus rgya byed bzhin/ oṃ sarba bhu ta sogs/ lan gsum/ rdor dril bcas g.yon bsngo rgya byas te/ g.yas pas bsgyur bkan gyis bsngo rgya re bca' zhing se gol gtogs nas/

na maḥsarba ta thā sogs/ lan gsum/ sgrub thabs las 566) bka' bsgo la/ ḍā 'ur/ ḍā bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bdag nyid dpal chen sogs/ shigaḥ ḍā bcad la/ oṃ hrīḥpadma sogs hūm̐ bzhi dang*/ drag sngags mjug gi u tsa ṭa ya nas ḍa 'ur bya zhing*/ bsrung 'khor ḍā bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag spros bral sogs/ gyuraḥ nas ḍa bcad cing bzhag la/ bsrung dmigs bzung nas rdor skor dril gsil bcas/ badzra ratna sogs/ brda sgo dbye ba la rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rang rig rtsal snang sogs/ mjug gi sngags la gsil/ brda phyag 'tshal ba la/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ na moḥ gzhi dbyings 'gyur med sogs/ mjug gi sngags la gsil/ dam bzung la rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rang rig sku gsum sogs/ mjug gi sngags la gsil/ byin 'bebs la/ ḍā 'ur/ ḍā bcas/ rang rta/ hūm̐ hrīḥ byin chen ngo mtshar sogs/ shogaḥ nas ḍā bcad cing sngags bcas ḍā 'ur/ mchod pa byin brlab la/ ḍā bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ snang srid gnyis bsdus sogs/ hoḥ mchod rol bya zhing bzhag bshags par rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hoḥ rang rig lha dang sogs/ āḥ gsil/ lha bskyed la/ rdor thal bzhi dril/ rang rta bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag zang thal sogs/ bsgomaḥ 567) ḍā bcas/ gdan gsum rdo rje'i sogs/ bam hoḥ nas ḍā 'ur/ spyan 'dren la/ ḍā bcas/ rang rta/ hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i sogs/ gsolaḥ nas ḍā bcad cing*/ sngags bcas ḍā 'ur/ bzhugs gsol la/ ḍā bcas la/ hūm̐ hrīḥ dam tshig rten dang sogs/ tīṣṭha lhan nas ḍā bcad cing bzhag phyag 'tshal la rdor thal dril 'dzin bcas/ na moḥ rang rig rang byung sogs/ mjug gi sngags la gsil/ mchod pa la/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hrīḥ snang srid dag mnyam sogs/ stsolaḥ nas gsil zhing dril sang bya/ rdor dril med par pad skor rang rgya bcas/ oṃ gu ru bīdya sogs/ hoḥ bsdu rgya se gol/ mchod rol/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hrī: dbang po yul drug sogs/

stsolaḥ gsil/ dril spang*/ pad skor rang rgya/ oṃ gu ru bīdyaḥ sogs/ hoḥ bsdu rgya se gol/ mchod rol/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hrīḥ nyon mongs ma spangs sogs/ stsolaḥ gsil dril sang*/ pad skor rang rgya/ oṃ gu ru bidya sogs/ hoḥ bsdu rgya se gol mchod rol/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hrīḥ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar sogs/ stsolaḥ bsil/ dril sang*/ pad skor rang rgya/ oṃ gu ru bīdya sogs/ kha hīḥ bsdu rgya se gol/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hrīḥ snang stong dbyer med sogs/ stsolaḥ bsil dril sang*/ pad skor rang rgya/ oṃ gu ru bidya sogs/ khā hiḥ bsdu rgya se gol/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hrīḥ rang rig dag pa sogs/ mjug gi 568) sngags la gsil/ mchod rol/ bstod pa/ rdor dril bcas/ rigs lnga'i spyi phyag yo ga'am/ rtsa gdangs bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral sogs/ bstodaḥ rdor thal dril 'dzin yo ga bkyag yod/ chos nyid ngang las sogs/ bstodaḥ mchod rol/ bshags pa la/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ lhug hoḥ bdag rtag gnyis snang sogs/ āḥ 'dzab la/ ḍā 'ur ḍa bcad/ rang rta/ hūm̐ḥ bdag nyid rig 'dus sogs/ bzlasaḥ ḍā 'ur gnyis bcad bya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ sogs/ hūm̐ḥ stong tsho bzla/ rang nyid rig 'dus kyi sogs/ bsamaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ hūm̐ āḥ lnga brgya bzlas/ rang nyid rig 'dus su sogs/ bsamaḥ hri ma ha ri sogs/ dza dzaḥ brgya rtsa/ siddhi nyis brgya bzlas mthar/ mtshams sbyar las/ shantiṃ puṣṭiṃ sogs/ rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i sogs/ cigaḥ rdor bsor dril bu gsil bzhin dbyangs gsal/ yig brgya/ rten snying*/ rdor thal dril gsil bcas/ hoḥ bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor sogs/ gsolaḥ mchod pa la/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hrīḥ snang srid dag mnyam sogs/ stsol/ mchod rol bcas/ oṃ gu ru bidya dha ra sa pa ri wa ra badzra arghaṃ sogs/ shabda rū pa sogs/ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba lingta sarba ta na ga ṇa pū dza hoḥ bstod pa la rdor dril bcas/

spyi phyag 569) rtsa gdangs/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral sogs/ tshig bzhi'i mtshams nas/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ 'og gi tshogs yul gnas dag sogs/ phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ mchod rol/ dge ba'i 'di yis sogs/ de nas tshogs mchod la/ bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba sogs/ dzaḥ bsdu rgya se gol/ bshags pa ye shes 'od zer las/ e ma hoḥ rang gi mdun gyi sogs/ bzlasaḥ yig brgya lan bdun/ hūm̐ḥ ye shes sgyu 'phrul sogs/ gsolaḥ yig brgya lan bdun/ rdzas bzhi'i bskang ba la/ ḍā 'ur/ ḍā bcas/ hūm̐ḥ snang ba snod kyi sogs/ mtshams rnams la yig brgya/ ḍā 'ur re bya zhing*/ sa thob shogaḥ yig brgya/ ḍā 'ur nyis gcod byas nas bzhag hoḥ nyan thos rang rgyal sogs/ sangs rgyas shogaḥ tshogs bsdus la/ ḍā 'ur/ ḍā bcas/ ram̐ ya ྃkham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ chos nyid nam mkha' sogs shogaḥ oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐ḥ bcu'i mtshams yig brgya/ ḍā 'ur/ yang na ḍā bcas/ hrīḥ snang srid dag pa sogs/ klong grol shogaḥ oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐ḥ bcu tshan mthar yig brgya ḍā 'ur/ de'i 'gros kyis brgya tsha 'don mthar ḍā bzhag thabs bya/ rig 'dzin bla ma'i sogs/ tshogs mchod phul ba'i sogs/ bskang ba'i lung byang las/ hoḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs/ stsolaḥ satwa stong rtsa/ dam tshig nyams chags 570) sogs/ nam mkha'i mthar thug sogs/ tshogs byin rlabs la/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rang nyid lha yi sogs/ gyuraḥ dril bu gsil bzhin/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ sogs/ maṃ pāṃ tāṃ/ pad skor rang gter ltar dang nam mdzod rgya spyi ltar se gol bcas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥ sogs/ lan gsum/ spyan 'dren la/ ḍā 'ur/ ḍā bcas/ rang rta/ hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min dag pa sogs/ shogaḥ ḍā bcad/ sngags bcas ḍā 'ur nyis bcad bya/ bdud rtsi 'bul ba la/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hrīḥ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar sogs/ mjug gi sngags la bsil/ tshogs phud la/ ḍā 'ur/ ḍā bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ snang srid ye dag sogs/ hoḥ ḍā 'ur/

don bskang la/ ḍā bcas/ oṃḥ kun khyab yangs pa'i sogs/ ha ho hrīḥ ḍā bcad/ pad skor/ rang rgya/ nam mkha' mdzod sngags lan bdun se gol/ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃḥ se gol phyir gdab/ spyan 'dren rta/ ḍā 'ur/ ḍā bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ chos sku skye ba sogs/ stsolaḥ ḍā bcad/ sngags bcas/ ḍā 'ur/ ḍā bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min chos dbyings sogs/ dngos grub stsolaḥ ḍā bcad nas bzhag rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hoḥ rtsa gsum srung mar sogs/ stsolaḥ dril bu gsil bzhin/ oṃ ga ṇa tsakra satwa sogs/ āḥ mchod rol/ bshags pa la/ rdor thal dril 'dzin 571)hoḥ rig 'dzin lha tshogs sogs/ bshags: dril bu gsil bzhin/ oṃ ga ṇa tsakra satwa sogs/ mtshams sbyar las/ tshogs 'gugs/ gtor snod sogs/ gyuraḥ bla mas rdor dril 'gugs rgya bcas/ na moḥ dkon mchog sogs/ khug cigaḥ lan gsum gyi rjes mar/ ḍā bcad/ sgo bzhi'i sngags bcas/ ḍā 'ur/ bsgral ba la/ ḍā bcas/ hrīḥ bdag nyid rig 'dzin sogs/ bsgralaḥ ḍā bcad/ drag sngags so lnga'i mjug tu/ gnod byed sarba sha trum ma ra ya phaṭaḥ btags pas bsgral/ bstab pa la/ ḍā 'ur/ ḍā bcad/ snang ba stong chen sogs*/ hoḥ gnam phud las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ ye shes sogs/ dzaḥ ḍā 'ur bzhag thabs bya/ tshogs la rol pa/ rdor bsor dril 'dzin/ hoḥ gsang ba bla med sogs/ hoḥ drang pa rol/ bsam lhun che chung rnams dang*/ tshes bcu'i gsol 'debs 'don/ mtshams sbyar las/ lhag ma byin rlabs/ rdor bsor dril 'dzin/ a mṛ ta gsil/ swa bha wa gsil/ stong par sogs/ pa gyuraḥ sngags brjod bzhin ḍā 'ur/ lhag ma la/ ḍā bcas/ pheṃ bhyoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan sogs/ khā hiḥ ḍā 'ur bzhag thabs bya/ rig 'dzin bla ma'i sogs/ chogs mchod phul ba'i sogs/ gsol kha la/ 572) mtshams sbyar gyi bskul ba'i mgo yi/ e las gnam lcags sogs/ gyuraḥ rdor dril bcas 'gugs rgya/ na moḥ rje btsun sogs/ khug cigaḥ lan gsum/ rang rgya/ dza:hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gong gi chos skyong gtor ma byin rlabs la/

rdor bsor dril 'dzin/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs/ gsil/ stong pa sogs gyur cigaḥ gsil/ sngags drug phyag drug rang rgya spyi ltar bya/ dregs pa rnam gsum gsol bsdus la/ ḍā 'ur/ ḍā bcas/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ ma skyes dag pa sogs/ myur 'grub mdzodaḥ bhyo la ma sogs/ khā hiḥ sngags lan gsum dang*/ gsol bsdus la/ oṃ ā hūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ btags la/ hūm̐ bhyam̐ḥ sngon tshe rgyal dbang sogs/ mdzodaḥ tshar nyer lnga sogs skabs dang bstun/ gzhan yang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ḥ gser skyems sogs/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud sogs/ kyai:rtsa gsum nor lha sogs/ rgyal ba'i bstan srung sogs/ mdzodaḥ ḍā bcad/ dril gsil/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa sogs/ bstod pa la ḍā bcas/ bhyoḥ dus gsum rgyal ba'i sogs/ bstodaḥ ḍā 'ur bzhag thabs/ sngon tshe o rgyan sogs/ gang zhig yid la sogs/ bstan pa'i dpal gyur sogs/ bskul ba la/ mtshams sbyar las/ rdor dril bcas 'gugs rgya/ na mo/ rje btsun sogs/ khug cigaḥ lan gsum gyi rjes mar ḍā bcad/ ḍā 'ur nang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ ḍā bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rab 'jigs dur khrod sogs/ mdzodaḥ 573) ḍā bcad/ mtshams sbyar las/ bdag mdun gyi sogs/ gyuraḥ sngags bcas/ ḍā 'ur/ chad tho la/ ḍā bcas/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ dus gsum dus med sogs/ phrin las mdzodaḥ ḍā 'ur nyis chod/ mtshams sbyar las/ bshal chu gtor ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ lan gsum la rdor thal dril bsil/ brtan ma la/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ bhyoḥ rig 'dzin padma sogs/ khā hiḥ mchod rol/ mtshams sbyar las/ rdor dril bcas 'gugs rgya/ na moḥ sangs rgyas kyi sogs/ khug cigaḥ ḍā bcad 'ur chems nang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam hoḥ gnod byed sogs/ bro mnan la/ ḍā bcad/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bdag nyid rig stong sogs/ ya nanaḥ ḍā 'ur bzhag thabs/ mtshams sbyar la/ gtor snod kha yar sogs/ mjug gi sngags la dril bu gsil bzhin nas zhus bya/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hoḥ dngos su 'byor dang sogs/ rgya mtshos mchodaḥ gsil/
rdor dril med par pad skor rang rgya bcas/ oṃ sarba ma hā gu ru bīdya dha ra sa pa ri wa ra badzra arghaṃ sogs/ shabda rū pa sogs/ dharma pra titstsha ye swā hāḥ bsdu rgya se gol/ rang rgya/

ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hiḥ ma hā rakta la khā hiḥ ma hā ba lingta la kha hiḥ bsdu rgya se gol/ mchod rol/ bstod pa la/ rdor dril bcas spyi phyag rtsa gdangs/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral sogs/ gzhan yang rig 'dzin 574) sogs/ bka' brgyud bla ma sogs/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa sogs/ bstod par 'os pa sogs/ dngos grub la/ rdor bsor dril 'dzin/ kye hoḥ rig 'dzin lha tshogs sogs/ stsolaḥ sngags la dril bu gsil bzhin rdzas la rol/ mchod rol/ bshags pa la/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hoḥ rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i sogs/ bshagasaḥ rdo rje thugs kar gtad cing dril bu gsil bzhin/ yig brgya/ dbyangs gsal/ rten snying*/ bsngo ba rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hoḥ bdag gis bla ma sogs/ shogaḥ gsil/ smon lam la/ hoḥ rig 'dzin bla ma'i sogs/ gsil/ lan gsum/ oṃ/ 'dir ni rten dang sogs/ swā hāḥ bsil bzhin nas 'thor/ gshegs bsdu la/ rdor bsor dril 'dzin/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ye shes dbyings kyi sogs/ ti āḥ rtsa sngags brjod bzhin gsil/ ye dharmā sogs/ gsil/ bkra shis la/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hūm̐ hrīḥ mdzad pa mtha' yas sogs/ bkra shis shogaḥ bstan pa'i dpal gyur sogs/ gnas 'dir nyin mo sogs nas su dza ya/ ḍā 'ur bzhag thabs/ de ltar 'grub par sogs/ cig na mo gu ruḥbadag gzhan rnams kyi sogs bsngo smon mtha' rgyas su bya'o/ zhes pa 'di nyid skyabs rje mkha' 'gro rin po che'i zhal rgyun bzhin zab gter gyi phyag bzhes mi nyams pa'i ched du slob 'bangs yongs kyi tha shal pa tshul khrims rdo rjes bris pa dge'o//
